'''Merumeru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] who fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], leading an [[Merumeru's volunteer soldiers|army of volunteers]] against the invading [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Merumeru was also a highly respected Wookiee Chieftain. However, at only 250 years old, he was considered relatively young for such a rank.

==Biography==
[[File:Wookiee_trench.png|thumb|left|250px|Merumeru leading the charge during the Battle of Kashyyyk]]
Merumeru was a [[Wookiee]] from the [[Kachirho clan]]<ref name="RotS:TVD" /> and at the age of 250 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old became a [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]]. At that time, he was one of the youngest Wookiees to ascend to the position. His mental prowess was refined by playing [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] and other similar games. In practice, he developed effective tactics in defending Wookiee territories and outposts from [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] raiders.<ref name="db" />

During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Merumeru led the beachfront defense at the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]],<ref name="db" /> leading [[Merumeru's volunteer soldiers|volunteer soldiers]] from all over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="RotS:TVD" /> against the invading [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist|Separatist Droid Army]]. Among the capable warriors following him into battle were [[Guanta/Legends|Guanta]], [[Lachichuk/Legends|Lachichuk]] and [[Salporin/Legends|Salporin]].<ref name="db" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Merumeru.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Merumeru in battle dress]]
Merumeru had a very sharp mind honed through playing dejarik and other games. He was a skilled tactician, whose tactics proved very useful in defending Wookiee outposts and territories against Trandoshan [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].<ref name="db" />

==Equipment==
During the Battle of Kashyyyk, Merumeru wore a crested [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] and a chest plate with the emblem of the Kachirho clan<ref name="RotS:TVD" /> and wielded [[Merumeru's battle staff|a battle staff]]. He also at times used a [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]].<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
Merumeru first appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars:'' Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], where he was played by [[Axel Dench]].<ref name="rots" /> The character was unnamed during production, and was referred to in the script as "a Wookiee chieftain."<ref name="db" />

The helmet that Merumeru wore in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']] wasn't completed in time for production, so he wore a blue helmet on his head for this scene, which was later replaced with a digital helmet in the final version.<ref name="db" />
